[[File:JediDiamondCrest.svg|thumb|The crest]]
A '''crest''' decorated the personal [[Barriss Offee's quarters/Legends|quarters]] of [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Barriss Offee/Legends|Barriss Offee]], and the door of the room across from [[Gender/Legends|hers]]. In Offee's quarters, the crest was emblazoned on the door and carpet. The design of the crest showed similarities<ref name="TCW">{{SW|url=explore/the-clone-wars/ep520|text="The Wrong Jedi" - ''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide|nolive=1}} {{C|slide 3}}</ref> with the winged roundel of the Jedi Order<ref name="NEGWT">[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (film)|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' film]]</ref> and the geometrically repeated [[Mirialan/Legends|Mirialan]] [[Tattoo/Legends|tattoos]] Offee and her master [[Luminara Unduli/Legends|Luminara Unduli]] wore on the face.<ref name="AOC">{{Film|II}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The crest was designed by [[David Le Merrer]] for "[[The Wrong Jedi]]," the twentieth and final episode of the [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' television series']] [[The Clone Wars: Season Five|fifth season]].<ref name="TCW" /> Personal emblems designed for Jedi quarters were introduced in [[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith|''Star Wars'': Episode III ''Revenge of the Sith'']], in the form of [[Yoda's crest]].<ref name="Principia">{{WebCite|url=http://www.metschanmedia.com/philip_metschan//portfolio.htm|text=Master Yoda's Crest (slide 8)|work=Principia Graphica (Philip Metschan's Official Site)|archivedate=20171115131603}}</ref>
